data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Jiguang JVerification SDK supporting Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides phone number verification, pre-fetching, and one-click login capabilities through native JIGUANG JVerification SDKs. It includes UI configuration for authorization pages and custom views.
use_when: You need phone number verification or one-click login in your mobile app.
You are targeting Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS platforms using Jiguang services.
avoid_when: You do not use Jiguang as your verification service provider.
You require standard SMS verification codes where this specific SDK is unsupported or not configured.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS.
Offers extensive UI customization options for authorization pages and login flows.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and native AppKeys.
Some features like SMS login are unsupported on certain platforms and return error codes.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring AppKey and channel in Android build.gradle, iOS SwiftPM/CocoaPods setups with iOS 15.0+ requirements, and HarmonyOS Navigation stack attachments.
